parameters.Description_EN: Manual handling drop tests. Drop height is determined by package weight and assurance level.
parameters.Description_ZH: 模擬人工搬運與包裹上下貨時的摔落。分為三次不同高度層級的跌落，確保邊角與面受到衝擊。
parameters.Drop Sequence: One corner, one edge, then remaining faces.

parameters.Description_EN: Static compression strength evaluation using a testing machine.
parameters.Description_ZH: 驗證紙箱與包裝材長時間堆疊在外箱上的靜態抗壓強度。使用公式計算目標下壓力 (Load)。
parameters.H: Maximum stacking height in transit or storage

tests.Application: Short term or low risk stacking

parameters.Description_EN: Simulates dynamic bottom-load compression during vehicle vibration.
parameters.Description_ZH: 模擬底層包裹在運輸途中承受上方貨物重量時的動態振動破壞力。
parameters.Variables: W: Package weight, H: Stack height, h: Package height

parameters.Description_EN: Air transport random vibration PSD profiles. High frequency focus.
parameters.Description_ZH: 模擬飛機貨艙的隨機振動光譜。空運的頻率較高、整體 Grms 能量更強。

parameters.Description_EN: Highway truck transport random vibration PSD profiles. Levels define test severity.
parameters.Description_ZH: 模擬公路卡車運輸的隨機振動光譜。ASTM D4169 自近版起已捨棄 AL I/II/III，改用 High / Medium / Low Test Level。
parameters.Test Duration: 180 minutes typical (or specific to DC routing)

parameters.Description_EN: Simulates unrestrained package bouncing and colliding in a vehicle.
parameters.Description_ZH: 模擬未固定的包裹在卡車車廂內跳動與互相碰撞。
parameters.Duration: Depends on DC, typically 40 to 120 minutes
parameters.Frequency: Typically ~4-5 Hz (rotary or vertical synchronous motion)

tests.Condition: Machine speed adjusted so package leaves table by ~1.6mm (1/16 in)

tests.Action: Monitor for ballooning, leakage, or burst
